newsitem.title: CHINA: Pudong Dev buys Everbright properties for shares.
newsitem.headline: Pudong Dev buys Everbright properties for shares.

text.p: Pudong Development Holdings Ltd said it planned to acquire two to three commercial properties in Shanghai with a market value of HK$1.0 billion from China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd in return for shares.
The company said in a statement on Friday that China Everbright Holdings would hold about 20 percent of Pudong Development's enlarged share capital.
Pudong Development said Hsiao Wen Fei, an independent investor who owns part of the properties, would hold an 11 percent stake in the company.
The company said it would pay 70 percent of the market value of the Shanghai properties.

The price per company share to be allotted to China Everbright and Hsiao shall be equal to 70 percent of an adjusted net asset value per share after taking into account the valuation of the China properties, it said.
Its net asset value was HK$3.82 per share as at March 31, 1997.
